delivered.body: Commercial Lease Agreement PARTIES. This Lease is between Calder Properties as Landlord and the Tenant. 1. PREMISES. The Landlord leases to the Tenant the premises at 400 Harbor Street. 2. RENT. The Tenant shall pay the monthly Base Rent of [Amount] due on the first day of each month. Late payments will incur a fee of [X%]. The Base Rent is subject to annual increases of [Y%]. 3. TERM. The lease term shall be for a period of sixty months, commencing on the Commencement Date and ending on the last day of the sixtieth month unless terminated earlier in accordance with this Lease. 4. ASSIGNMENT. The Tenant shall not assign without the Landlord's consent.
